description: Routing overlay for the approved Florida rules. rules.routing.normalize() applies it to fl-declarations-rules.approved.json and writes fl-rules.normalized.json. Classifications come from RULE_ROUTING_AUDIT.md.
reviewer: Prototype reviewer (acting as implementation lead; not legal counsel)
route_approval_policy: A route is approved only where the 2026-09-23 review decided that question: the declarations template route of a rule approved for declarations. Every other route is unapproved until its owner approves it. Route approval does not change the legacy `approved` flag, which the pipeline still reads.
normalization_policy: Several implementation responsibilities for one normative requirement are routes on one rule. Distinct normative requirements bundled into one source row become separate rules that keep the row's provenance.
